questions.prompt: What is the big idea of The Monarch Butterfly Life Cycle?
choices: Monarchs change through four life stages and migrate.
Only this monarch has six legs, four wings, and two antennae.
Only a striped caterpillar hatches, eats milkweed, and grows and grows.
questions.answer: Monarchs change through four life stages and migrate.
questions.rationale: This monarch has six legs, four wings, and two antennae. A striped caterpillar hatches, eats milkweed, and grows and grows. Monarchs cross a continent. No one butterfly makes the whole round trip. New generations carry it on. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: Monarchs change through four life stages and migrate.
